name: Yanyang Easement Rails (MTR 3.x)
description: Adds the cubic parabola and half-wave sine easement (transition) curve rail path algorithms, ported from MTR-Yanyang's tsc-1.21.x branch (Transport Simulation Core), to Minecraft Transit Railway 3.x as a runtime patch. Supports YMTR 1.20.1-3.4.4 and later. 为 MTR 3.x 添加三次抛物线与半波正弦两种缓和曲线轨道路径算法，支持 YMTR 3.4.4 及以上版本。
